lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 4.1 million buildings with an average data age of 6 years, providing a spatial inventory of building structures for exposure assessment in disaster risk analysis.
